  | "mot-sh-str"
  | "mot-sh-fn"
  | "mot-sh-num"
  | "mot-sh-prop"
  | "mot-sh-var"
  | "mot-sh-punct"

export const CODE_SYNTAX_PARTS: ReadonlyArray<{ t: string; c: MotShClass }> = [
  { t: "import ", c: "mot-sh-kw" },
  { t: "{ ", c: "mot-sh-punct" },
  { t: "generateText", c: "mot-sh-fn" },
